dsa.title: DSA / Channel Partner Agreement
dsa.intro: This Agreement is made on {{effective_date}} between {{company}}, a proprietorship having its Head Office at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh ("the Company"), and {{party_name}}, {{city}}, represented by {{contact}} ("the Partner"). It is read together with the Company's Master Declaration & Terms of Service and sets out the terms on which the Partner refers customers to the Company.
dsa.recital: The Company provides loan assistance and customer-support services in association with authorised banks, NBFCs and other service providers. The Partner wishes to refer prospective customers as a non-exclusive Direct Selling Agent, and the Company agrees to engage the Partner on the terms below.

clauses.b: The Partner is appointed as a non-exclusive agent to (a) identify and refer prospective customers for loan, MSME, EMI-finance and insurance assistance, (b) help them with preliminary documentation, and (c) share product information issued by the Company. Each activity is permitted only where the necessary permission and partner contract exist. The Partner acts as an independent agent and not as an employee, partner or legal representative of the Company.

The Partner has no authority to sanction or promise a loan, fix an interest rate, collect money in the Company's name except against an official Company receipt, or sign any contract, financial commitment or representation on the Company's behalf without the Company's written permission.

The Partner shall promote only services authorised by the Company and shall not quote false interest rates, promise guaranteed loans, announce fake offers or make any unfair promise. The Partner shall not collect or share personal or financial information without the customer's consent.

The Partner shall not charge any fee to a customer, submit forged, false or incomplete documents, misuse customer data, or receive any loan amount or EMI in a personal account. The Partner is solely responsible for any fraud, false document or misleading promotion by the Partner or its team. Any breach is a ground for immediate suspension or termination.

The Partner is entitled to commission of {{commission}}% on the disbursed loan amount of each lead referred by the Partner that is successfully converted and disbursed, as set out in the written Commission Schedule. Commission is payable only under that Schedule; basis of payment, eligibility, timelines, TDS/GST and any clawback shall be as stated in it.
Commission is paid monthly after successful disbursal and subject to collection as per Company policy. No oral assurance creates any right to additional commission or payment.
If a referred loan is found to be fraudulent, or is cancelled within the cooling-off period, the commission paid on it shall be recovered or adjusted against future payouts.
Commission is paid after deduction of tax at source (TDS) and GST where applicable. The Partner is responsible for its own tax filings.
All customer data, processes and business information shared with the Partner shall be kept strictly confidential during and after the term of this Agreement.

The Partner shall comply with all applicable KYC/AML requirements and Company policies when referring and assisting customers, and shall give accurate details of its legal identity, registration and permissions (PAN / GST / Udyam where applicable).
This Agreement is effective from {{effective_date}} for {{term_months}} months and may be renewed by mutual written consent.
Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving {{notice_days}} days' written notice to the other. Termination does not affect obligations that have already arisen.

The Company is a proprietorship carrying on business as Pratishtha Finance Services ("PFS"). It is an independent financial services and customer-support business that operates under applicable law and the terms of its authorised bank, NBFC, insurance and other service-provider partners. The Company is not a bank and is not an RBI-registered NBFC. Udyam / MSME registration is not a licence for banking, lending, accepting public deposits or operating as an NBFC, and shall not be represented as one.

Approval, interest rate, tenure, eligibility, disbursal and all other terms of any loan, card, EMI finance or insurance product are decided solely by the relevant authorised bank, NBFC or insurer (the "Regulated Entity"). The Company does not guarantee approval of any loan or product, and no person shall state or imply otherwise.

Without specific written legal permission, the Company shall not be presented as a bank, NBFC or deposit-taking institution. The Company shall not accept unauthorised recurring deposits, fixed deposits, investments or public deposits, and no party shall promise any fixed or guaranteed return on behalf of the Company.

Loan amounts and EMIs shall be paid only through the channel prescribed by the relevant Regulated Entity or through Company-issued receipts and official payment channels. No employee, agent or retailer of the Company shall receive any loan amount or EMI from a customer in a personal account, wallet or UPI handle.
Before any service fee is charged to a customer, its purpose, amount and refund policy shall be disclosed to the customer in writing. No fee shall be charged that has not been so disclosed.

Personal and financial information shall be collected only for a lawful, clearly stated purpose and with the customer's consent. It shall not be disclosed to any unauthorised third party. Sharing with a Regulated Entity or service partner shall be in accordance with applicable law, the customer's consent and the relevant contract. Each party shall maintain reasonable security safeguards, restrict access to those who need it, keep proper records, and use, store, retain and delete data in line with applicable data-protection law.

Each party shall comply with the RBI Digital Lending Directions, 2025, applicable consumer-protection and data-protection laws, and the requirements of the relevant Regulated Entity, as in force from time to time.

Neither party shall use the other's name, logo, documents or brand without the other's prior written permission, and the use of any PFS name, logo, documents or authorised material shall cease upon termination or expiry of this Agreement.

Neither party may transfer, assign or sub-contract this Agreement, or any right, commission or payment obligation under it, to any third party without the other party's prior written consent. If the Company undergoes a legal restructuring or a change of name or ownership, it shall give written notice to the Partner. Any transfer of this Agreement to another company, group entity or subsidiary shall follow the legal process required, the other party's consent and, where applicable, fresh customer consent. Customer information and financial records shall be transferred only for a lawful purpose, on proper grounds and in accordance with law. A transfer shall not extinguish any payment, confidentiality, grievance or statutory obligation that has already arisen.

In the event of fraud, a data breach, unlawful activity or a serious breach of this Agreement, the Company may suspend or terminate it immediately in accordance with applicable law and this Agreement. After termination, pending payments, customer grievances, data-protection and confidentiality obligations shall continue to apply.

Any customer, retailer, business associate, franchisee, employee or service partner may lodge a grievance. Contact: Email pratishthafinance@gmail.com, Website https://pratishtha.pro, Phone +91 72330 23547. The Company shall acknowledge and resolve grievances under its Grievance Policy and applicable law. Complaints relating to a bank or NBFC shall also be forwarded to that Regulated Entity's grievance redressal mechanism.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute through mutual discussion and a written complaint. If the dispute remains unresolved, the courts of competent jurisdiction at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh shall have jurisdiction in accordance with applicable law.

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject and supersedes any oral assurance. No party acquires any right to additional commission or payment on the basis of an oral assurance. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties. If any provision is held unenforceable, the remainder continues in force. By signing, each party confirms that it has read and understood this Agreement and accepts it voluntarily.

lender.recital: The Company operates the PFS Virtual Card programme through which customers access credit facilities funded by authorised banks and NBFCs. The Lender wishes to take part as a funding partner and the Company agrees to empanel the Lender on the terms below.

clauses.b: The Company empanels the Lender as a non-exclusive Lending Partner for the PFS Virtual Card programme(s): {{programmes}}.
The Lender shall make available a funding pool of up to {{pool_limit}}. Card limits sanctioned by the Lender shall not, in total, exceed this pool.
No single card shall carry a limit above {{max_card_limit}} unless both parties agree in writing.
Eligibility, credit limit and pricing of each card are decided solely by the Lender. The Company only collects the customer's application and consent and does not guarantee any approval or repayment.

Customer repayments shall reach the Lender through the channel the Lender prescribes or through Company-issued receipts, and shall be remitted per the payout rules recorded on the platform, with a statement of every collection. No Company employee or retailer shall receive any amount in a personal account.

The Company's fee or commission for sourcing and servicing is as stated in the Payout Rules recorded on the platform from time to time and visible to the Lender in its dashboard. Payment terms, TDS/GST and any clawback shall be as stated in the written schedule.

Each party shall provide only the services described in this Agreement. Each party is solely responsible for its own legal identity, registrations, permissions and statutory compliance, and the Lender shall give the Company accurate details of its legal identity, registration and authorisations.

The Lender confirms that it holds every licence and approval required for lending and shall comply with applicable RBI regulations, KYC/AML and fair-practice requirements, and shall inform the Company immediately of any change in its regulatory status.
Both parties shall handle customer complaints fairly and promptly. The Company shall forward grievances about credit decisions to the Lender, which shall respond within a reasonable time.
Each party shall keep the other's business information, pricing and customer data confidential during and after the term of this Agreement.
This Agreement is effective from {{effective_date}} for {{term_months}} months and may be renewed by mutual written consent.
Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving {{notice_days}} days' written notice. Cards already issued shall continue to be serviced until fully repaid.
